_comment: bb-ldo P3 parts list. Build qty 5, JLC PCBA single-sided (all SMT top; J1/J2 THT, hand-soldered after PCBA). Every LCSC code/stock/price verified live via parts_search.py at selection time (2026-08-16). Knowledge records applied: linear-regulator-1117-output-cap-esr-window (C2 ESR window, C1/C2 dielectric+uF floor), linear-regulator-fixed-variant-min-load (confirms no R1). Five distinct parts, five refdes (J1=J2 part).

alternates.note: Same SOT-223 3-pin+tab AMS1117-3.3 pinout family (GND/ADJ-VOUT-VIN, tab=VOUT is the de-facto industry-standard footprint for this part number). Extended tier, stock 1.8M, ~4x cheaper. RISK: this is a different die (clone) - blocks.md's copper-area/theta_JA sizing table is C6186's vendor data specifically; if swapped in, P8's thermal waiver evidence would need re-checking against this alternate's own datasheet before relying on it for the same copper-area margin.

parts.role: The block under study. LCSC C6186 re-verified live (stock/price only; choice not re-opened - ruled at P1/P2 for its copper-area-to-theta_JA table on 1/16in FR-4 1oz, blocks.md s.3/s.9). Single-source risk at the Basic tier is real: it is the only JLC Basic fixed-3.3V part with a usable thermal-sizing curve for this 2-layer board (blocks.md s.3, rejecting MCP1825S-3302E/DB, AP7361C-33E-13, MIC29300-3.3WU-TR, HT7533-1).

Cin at VIN pin. AVX "TAJ" = solid MnO2 tantalum chip series (standard, not the T5x-prefixed polymer family). 10uF/tantalum per linear-regulator-1117-output-cap-esr-window (cin_uf=10, cin_dielectric=tantalum). 16V rating = 3x derating on the 5.25V worst-case rail (spec floor 2x). No ESR requirement applies to Cin (only Cout is the compensation element); 3ohm@100kHz reported here for completeness, from LCSC's own parametric attribute.

Cout at VOUT pin - the compensation element (linear-regulator-1117-output-cap-esr-window / linear-regulator-esr-zero-compensation). ESR 0.8ohm@100kHz is LCSC's own parametric attribute for this exact part, taken as its datasheet ESR figure: inside the knowledge record's 0.3-22ohm acceptance window, and just above blocks.md s.6's tighter 0.3-0.5ohm merged target (AMS1117's own ceiling text) - no orderable 22uF part surveyed lands inside 0.3-0.5ohm (closest was this part and TAJD226K035RNJ/C7225 at 0.9ohm, 293D226X9035E2TE3/C1952732 at 0.6ohm but 4x pricier/3909 stock). Per blocks.md s.6.1's own fallback rule ('slightly ABOVE 0.5 ohm, never below 0.3'), this is the closest-ESR, cheapest, best-stocked candidate that clears it. Vishay "293D" = solid MnO2 molded chip series (Vishay's polymer tantalum lines are the T5x-prefixed series - T58MM226M6R3C0300/C215879 at 300mΩ/6.3V was surveyed and rejected on BOTH grounds: likely polymer-class ESR at the window's exact lower edge, and 6.3V under the >=10V floor). 16V rating = 4.8x derating on 3.3V (record wants 2x min; blocks.md wanted 3x, i.e. >=10V) - comfortably clears both.

parts.value: 2-position 5.08mm pitch THT screw terminal, 250V/18A, wire 14-30AWG (0.05-2.5mm2 per LCSC attribute)
parts.role: J1 (DC input, left edge) and J2 (3V3 output, right edge) - same part, two refdes per sheets.md. Exact orderable variant: category "Screw Terminal Blocks" (fixed block, not a 2-piece pluggable/socket system), 2 position, 5.08mm pitch, through-hole, M2.5 screw, 14-30AWG wire (matches the requirements.md s.8/owner-answer-8 0.2-2.5mm2 range at both ends - LCSC's own mm2 attribute states 2.5). 18A current rating clears the 515mA(J1)/500mA(J2) load by >30x. No SMT-mount equivalent exists in this pitch/wire class in the JLC catalog (parts_search returned zero rows for both "SMD screw terminal block 5.08mm 2P" and "surface mount terminal block 5.08") - THT is not a preference gap, it is the only orderable option, so J1/J2 are hand-soldered after PCBA per requirements.md s.7.

refdes_notes.J1: THT screw terminal, hand-solder after PCBA. GND pin lands in the B.Cu return pour.
refdes_notes.J2: THT screw terminal, hand-solder after PCBA. +3V3 pin lands in the large solid-connected F.Cu heatsink pour (connect: solid, no thermal relief per blocks.md s.9.10) - needs a hot iron with real thermal mass (blocks.md s.5).
